sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!
ParticipantA: So, what kind of pets do you have?
ParticipantB: Oh, I have a dog.
ParticipantA: That's great! What kind of dog is it?
ParticipantB: It's a golden retriever.
ParticipantA: I love golden retrievers. I used to have one when I was a kid.
ParticipantB: Yeah, they're such great dogs.
ParticipantA: Definitely. What do you like about them?
ParticipantB: I think they're just so friendly and loyal.
ParticipantA: Yeah, that's definitely true. What do you do with your dog? Do you take it for walks or anything?
ParticipantB: Oh, all the time. We love going on hikes together.
ParticipantA: That sounds like so much fun. I used to go on hikes with my dog too.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's a great way to spend time together and get some exercise.
ParticipantA: Definitely. I don't have a pet right now, but I used to have a cat.
ParticipantB: Oh, I love cats too. What did your cat like to do?
ParticipantA: My cat loved to curl up in my lap and sleep. It was such a comfort to have her around.
ParticipantB: Yeah, cats are great for that. They can be so comforting.
ParticipantA: Definitely. What do you think about pets in general?
ParticipantB: I think they're great. They can bring so much joy to your life.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I agree. I'm a little bit skeptical about the whole pet thing, though.
ParticipantB: Really? Why is that?
ParticipantA: I don't know, I just feel like it's a lot of work to take care of a pet.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I can see how that would be. But I think it's worth it if you're willing to put in the effort.
ParticipantA: I agree. It's just that I've never really been a big animal person.
ParticipantB: Oh, I see. Well, I've always loved animals. I think they're so cute and interesting.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I can understand that. I just don't have the same connection with them that some people do.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get it. But I think that everyone has their own unique perspective on things.
ParticipantA: Definitely. Well, it was nice talking with you.
ParticipantB: Yeah, you too. Thanks for chatting with me.
